description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallanda Kothmaale D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District - Cad. Map No. 330300 (23/0671)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, land classifications, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
